segments.text: Class Representative of the Year 1 "Snow" class, and a classmate of Miya's. Has an earnest and hardworking personality. As a hard-nosed person, she often finds herself in leadership positions. She’s what you might call a high-class tsundere girl.

While she naturally does well academically and has common sense, whenever she gets into it with Miya, she always gets outreasoned and frequently stomps her feet. Having an unusually strong sense of shame, she gets flustered and briefly digs herself into a hole when thrust into a romantic relationship.
The half-Japanese daughter of a foreign company with a British mother. Built like a model, and the owner of enormous breasts.

A student of the Year 1 "Snow" class, and a classmate of Risa's. A prominent genius on campus, but has difficulty in social situations. Doesn’t really take issue with people other than Risa, and socializes as little as possible.

Whenever she speaks with Risa it's always abusive, but she's actually covering her own embarrassment. Her speech and behavior always keep others at a distance. She rarely shows her soft side and is unflappable. When she does show her soft side, she becomes timid and casts nervous glances from beneath her lashes.

Although you wouldn’t guess it from the way she talks, her behavior is actually quite ladylike. Possessing one of the most prominent intellects on campus, she has been offered the chance to study abroad and even skip grades, but she hates interacting with others, so she enrolled in the not particularly academically demanding school for high-class girls, St. Michael's.
Translated from Getchu and Yurin Yurin

A new teacher at St. Michael's who is also Runa's older sister and Takako's former tutor. Stylish and stunningly beautiful — the perfect woman. Outgoing and easygoing. Although she’s blunt and untidy, for some reason she has the kind of likable personality that’s impossible to hate.

Rena is an alumnus of St. Michael's, and at the time, the teachers all praised her for being a well-behaved lady. But in actuality, she was chasing skirts left and right, regardless if they were seniors or juniors. It’s rumored her lovers numbered at nearly a hundred.

A first-year student who was accepted into the escalator school of St. Michael's through taking outside entrance exams.
Shortly after enrolling, she set a new national record in the 100 meter dash and became an instant celebrity on campus.
She has a kind disposition, and has to intervene when she sees someone in trouble. Because of that tendency, she's earned the nickname, "Sir Knight" (騎士様).
She serves as vice-representative of her class, and was chosen along with class representative Sayuki as one of the academy’s Best Couples.

A classmate of Rikka's. Serving as class representative, she lives with her grandfather, who is apparently descended from samurai who once defended a castle.
Her name combined with her noble lineage has earned her the nickname "Snow White" (白雪姫).
Additionally, being both beautiful and brilliant, a scholar and an athlete, she’s been touted by many as the second coming of "The Perfect Lady".

In no time at all after her enrollment, these abilities result in her being entrusted with the role of Chairman of the Environmental Improvement Committee, which is essentially the academy's student council.
Translated from post with info from Dengeki Hime

A fifth/sixth grade primary school student and recent transfer at St. Michael's. Smart, mature and highly charismatic for her age, Runa has won many fans in her class but she is very interested with her teacher Takako and declares she belongs to her.

Runa harbors resentment over her older sister Rena, yet unseen in the story, who frequently leaves her alone while she goes out on business trips. Runa's older sister is Takako's former crush, which leads to the relationship between Runa and Takako once they meet for the first time in St. Michael's.

ミカ女初等部にやって来た転校生で貴子の恋人。
高圧的で高飛車な女王様タイプで、大人びた態度と物言いで、周囲を振り回す。
「せんせいはわたしのモノ」と公言してはばからず、そのくせ人の意見は聞かない自己中心的性格。
こと貴子に関してはかなりの嫉妬深さだが、直情的に激高するのではなく、静かに脅し文句を言う感じ。
基本的にサドっぽく、なにかと自分の都合の良い様に解釈しては、Ｓっぽく婉然と微笑む。
ミカ女附属の中等部１年生で貴子の恋人。高圧的で高飛車な女王様タイプで、大人びた態度と物言いで周囲を振り回す。
「せんせいはわたしのモノ」と公言してはばからず、そのくせ人の意見は聞かない自己中心的性格。
基本的にドエスで、なにかと自分の都合の良い様に解釈しては、婉然と微笑む女王様体質。
中等部に進学するも、相変わらずのリーダーシップとカリスマで、クラスに君臨している模様。

初等部六年级学生（网络小说版为五年级），得知贵子是姊姊唯一保持柏拉图关系的学妹后，为接近她而回到日本转读米卡女校。表面上是高傲任性而嗜虐的女王型性格，面对身分和年龄差极大的贵子仍公然宣布“老师属于我的”…游戏版设定上回日本和贵子同居前处于独居状态，某程度是全主角中家庭环境最恶劣的一人。就连有如遗传的天才级学力、领导才能及待人处事方式也是她努力学会，精神年龄和外表相反地非常成熟，只有和贵子独处时生活习惯才会像一名约10岁的小孩。
对贵子的称呼是“老师”，但文字上有如为了显出年龄和性格特征而用平假名的“せんせい”。身材数值全是比玲绪略高。
声：上田幸姫 (bgm.tv查不到…)

むしろカミングアウトしたい気持ちを「あの娘は私の教え子なのよ～っ!?」と必死に堪えている。

今も瑠奈とは同棲中で、大人としてあれこれ子供らしい振る舞いを教えようとするも、逆に振り回されっぱなし。
とはいえ押しの強い瑠奈に迫られ悪い気はせず、瑠奈の外見、高貴な立ち振る舞いに見惚れる事しばし。
瑠奈の進学に伴い担任から外れてしまったが、その分私生活でべったりになってしまっている模様。
